description: Swipe to merge matching tiles and chase the 2048 tile. One undo per game, plus a roomier 5x5 board.

name: Sliding Puzzle
description: Slide the numbered tiles back into order in as few moves as you can. Classic 15-puzzle, mobile friendly.

name: Minesweeper
description: Clear every safe square without tripping a mine. Long-press or right-click to plant a flag.

name: Sudoku
description: Fill the 9x9 grid so every row, column, and box holds the digits 1 to 9 exactly once.

name: Gem Swap
description: Swap neighbouring gems to line up three or more and rack up cascading combos before the clock runs out.

name: Whack-a-Mole
description: Thirty seconds, one hammer, endless moles. Tap fast and build a streak without hitting a bomb.

name: Reaction Time Test
description: Wait for green, then tap. Five rounds, averaged, to find out how fast your reflexes really are.

name: Block Dodge
description: Steer through a thickening rain of blocks. One touch ends the run, so every near miss counts.

name: Tap Flyer
description: Tap to flap, glide through the gaps, and see how far you get before gravity wins.

name: Word Scramble
description: Unscramble the letters against the clock. Hints cost points, so trust your instincts first.

name: Word Search
description: Drag across the grid to find every hidden word. Words run in any direction, including backwards.

name: Hangman
description: Guess the hidden word one letter at a time. Six wrong guesses and the round is over.

name: Memory Match
description: Flip the cards two at a time and pair them all up. Fewer moves means a better score.

name: Solitaire
description: Klondike solitaire with tap-to-move controls built for a phone. Clear all four foundations to win.

name: Snake
description: Eat, grow, and chain apple combos for big multipliers. Levels speed you up and drop walls into the arena.

name: Breakout
description: Bounce the ball, break every brick, and keep the paddle under it. Six rows, three lives.

name: Tetro Blocks
description: Rotate and drop falling blocks to clear lines. Hold a piece for later, chain combos, and survive the climbing speed.

name: Pong
description: Classic two-paddle tennis against a sharp computer opponent. First to eleven takes it.

name: Click Empire
description: Tap to earn, buy upgrades, let the generators run themselves. A tiny idle empire in one minute.

name: Tower Stacker
description: Time your tap to drop each slab dead centre. Miss and the tower narrows until nothing is left.

name: Trivia Quiz
description: Ten quick-fire questions across tech, science, and pop culture. Answer fast for bonus points.

name: Simon Says
description: Watch the colour sequence, then repeat it back. It grows by one every single round.

name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Three in a row against a perfect computer opponent, or pass the phone for two-player mode.

name: Trace Master
description: Trace the shape with one unbroken stroke. Scored on how closely you hug the line.

name: Hoop Shot
description: Drag back, aim, and release. Real gravity, a moving hoop, and sixty seconds on the clock.
